run_caffe2_benchmark: run a Caffe2 benchmark on an exported ONNX model to report FLOPS
run_benchmark_with_prefix: run a Caffe2 benchmark using a model protobuf file prefix for init and predict nets
run_benchmark_with_custom_batch: run a Caffe2 benchmark with a custom batch size and image dimension
review_main: review the main function that loads Caffe2 init and predict protobuf nets and runs a benchmark
test_benchmark_net: test the Caffe2 benchmark script by providing init and predict protobuf model files
